output.subject: We've received your complaint about your statements
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for contacting us about your statements. We have received your complaint, and a member of our team has read it carefully.

You told us that you called to update your address on July 18 when you moved, and that you have a confirmation number from that call. You mentioned that your old roommate let you know your last two statements were still being delivered to your previous apartment, and that those statements show your full account number and balance. You want to know who else may have seen your information.

We understand how unsettling it is to learn that your personal financial details may have reached a previous address, and we're sorry for the worry this has caused.

A specialist team is now reviewing your complaint and will respond to you within 10 business days. If you could keep the confirmation number from your call to hand, it may be helpful as the review goes ahead.

Kind regards,

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Check whether an address change was recorded on or around Jul 18 and whether it matches the customer's confirmation number.
Confirm which address is currently on file before the next statement is produced, so a further statement does not go to the old address.
Decide whether to offer any account security measures given that the full account number and balance were on the statements.
Decide how to respond to the customer's question about who may have seen their information.
The reply does not say whether the mailing address on file is correct or has been updated; decide whether to confirm this.
The customer gave a cell number in the complaint; consider whether a call is appropriate alongside the written reply.
